Medium: intermittent spare-part forecasting is consequential; data cannot establish actual stockout or inventory savings.
High for data size, medium for models: parsing demonstrated and CPU fallback is small; training costs remain estimates.
Medium-high: a local historical replay with missingness and intervals is bounded.

gate_evidence.G1: Section 1 and the closest-work evidence support a concrete failure mode; the new method's benefit is untested.
gate_evidence.G2: Learning, adaptation or systematic model evaluation is central to the question.
gate_evidence.G3: Section 4 defines trainable objectives, heads or policies; no paid inference API is required.
gate_evidence.G4: Section 5 records an original public release or author-documented loading route, existing labels and the access-check limit.
gate_evidence.G5: Evaluation uses existing annotations or observed values; no new participants, questionnaires or expert labels.
gate_evidence.G6: Distinct model-level gap beyond current intermittent-demand probability and combination work is unresolved.
gate_evidence.G7: A preprocessing correction alone is insufficient; the learned likelihood/sharing contributions need stronger justification.
gate_evidence.G8: Section 7 defines objective outcomes, grouping, controls and uncertainty treatment.
gate_evidence.G9: The bounded core and fallback in Section 5 are plausible within the team window; training costs remain estimates.
gate_evidence.G10: Three contributions share one problem and infrastructure but can each be assessed against the unchanged baseline.
gate_evidence.G11: Core design uses CPU work or an occasional modest GPU; no specialised sensor, paid service or continuous server GPU.
gate_evidence.G12: Section 5 records source terms and a bounded offline use; no deployment or high-stakes benefit is assumed.
gate_evidence.G13: Section 7 identifies an interpretable negative result if the proposed method does not outperform the baseline.

scoring_policy.precision_note: Decimal totals reflect weighted arithmetic, not measurement precision or statistical certainty.
scoring_policy.scope: Original three assessments retained; ten additional candidates searched and evaluated on 28 October. No model training or timing experiment.

scoring_policy.normalisation: sum((rating / 5) * weight) / 98 * 100; round only the final total to one decimal place.
